$comment: The V1.0 baseline for V2 (#387). Plan: https://github.com/n0mad-ai/bastra-recall/issues/387#issuecomment-5846047786. Owner decision 2026-09-26 (https://github.com/n0mad-ai/bastra-recall/issues/387#issuecomment-5846178590): #279 and #325 are not prerequisites, and the #305 window values ARE the live half, without a confirmation window after #681 unless the readout shows lanes off-budget. This file is immutable once merged. A correction is a new registration_version with a $comment saying what changed and why, never an in-place edit.
$comment_version_2: v2 (2026-09-27): ADDITIONS ONLY, no v1 measured value changed; v2 only fills fields v1 marked 'not measured'. Adds the offline half (run A twice + determinism check + pool coverage to depth 40), the gold-set manifest hashes (vault, configuration, dataset) and the query slices the gold labels support. Everything v1 froze (live half, manifest pins, tolerances reference) is untouched. The flag registry and the M2-M6 gates are still open.
$comment_status: v1 froze the live half (B) and the manifest pins. v2 adds the offline half (A: two gold-set runs, determinism check) and the query slices the gold labels carry. The flag registry and the M2-M6 gates are NOT in this registration yet. Every such field below says 'not measured', 'not measurable' or 'not derived' instead of carrying a guessed value.

code.$comment: post-#681 main (PR #681 merged 2026-09-26 as cb3ab03), deployed 2026-09-27: daemon, core and statusline dist plus the hook stub were rebuilt from this commit. Read back after the deploy:

tolerances.$comment: Referenced unchanged. git log on m1-tolerances.json shows nothing after 2026-08-29, so the tolerances were registered before any V2 baseline run (answers review point 2 on #387).

vault.$comment: vault_size from /health at deploy time. No vault content hash was computed in this step; it belongs to run A.
vault.$comment_v2: v2: the goldset-run manifest hash (sha256 over sorted 'id updated' lines), identical in both run A artifacts. The vault is live: it held 1335 memories at run A vs 1334 at deploy, so 'hash' (deploy time) stays not measured and this field names the vault state run A actually measured.

manifest.$comment_configuration_hash: v2: goldset-run manifest hash over {k: 10, floor: 30, hybrid: true}; identical in both run A artifacts. It covers the runner configuration only, not daemon env flags (that is the flag registry, still open).
manifest.$comment_dataset_hash: v2: goldset-run datasetHash over the 12 gold files of run A (699 cases); identical in both artifacts. Gold files are private under ~/.bastra/eval-goldset.

window.$comment: Closed ~19 h early by owner decision on 2026-09-27. The readout shows the missing hours cannot change the verdict (plan needs 27 more calls).

measured_on.$comment: The window ran on 09bcfd8 (daemon and stub, no restart in the window), i.e. pre-#681. The manifest pins e15090e because that is what runs now. Per the owner decision of 2026-09-26 these window values are the live baseline without a post-#681 confirmation window. The readout shows only one lane off its p90 target (none, by 7 ms); whether that triggers the decision's 'off-budget' exception is left to the owner.

data_basis.$comment_686: The productive log still contains the test-suite rows from #686; the physical purge is pending the owner. All values here are computed with the #686 exclusion filter applied to a copy of the window's files (production files untouched). Gated output is byte-identical with and without the filter; only the saves section moves (84 -> 71 attempted).

live_half.command: BASTRA_LOG_PATH=<copy filtered by the #686 predicate> node packages/daemon/dist/cli.js logs --stats --since 537211s

plan.$comment: 3 of min N 30, all from one Codex session; Claude Code produced zero plan-lane calls in the window

not_measurable_from_this_window.p99_per_lane: not measurable — the readout reports median, p90 and max, not p99
not_measurable_from_this_window.degraded_rate_per_lane: not measurable — the readout reports degradation only for the none lane (39 calls with a degraded dense arm)
not_measurable_from_this_window.context_tokens_per_session: not measurable — the readout does not include the shadow ledger
not_measurable_from_this_window.false_interruptions: not measurable — no labelled source for false interruptions exists in this window

offline_half.$comment: v2 (2026-09-27). Run A twice plus the determinism check, all on this host (manifest.host) against the live vault, with the daemon on e15090e. Raw artifacts are private under ~/.bastra/eval-runs; only aggregates are here (C-025).

measured_on.$comment: Runs executed from a clean checkout of 8c6bdcb. 'git diff --stat e15090e 8c6bdcb' touches only CHANGELOG.md and this file, so the measured code is the pinned e15090e code. packages/core/dist was the one built for the e15090e deploy.
measured_on.embedding_model: embeddinggemma:latest (ollama digest 85462619ee72), store copied from the vault, 1335 vectors, 0 backfilled

determinism_check.selection: answerable non-probe rows of run A #1 with a served top-1, sorted by case id, first 200
determinism_check.passes: 2 per process, 2 processes (4 passes in total)
determinism_check.$comment: The rebaselining reference: a new host embeds the same 200 queries and compares against the private pass-1 vectors in the artifact. Raw similarity = cosine(query vector, stored vector of the served top-1 memory). This is a same-host check; the cross-host half of the protocol needs a second machine.

reproduction.$comment: All six manifest hashes (code, git, vault, model, config, dataset) are equal, and all 699 result rows are field-for-field identical (0 rows differ), so the second run reproduces the first well inside m1-tolerances v4.

recall_at_pool.$comment: goldset-run measures at the production pool k=10 only, so recall@pool@10 equals recall@10. The deeper pool (up to HOP_SEED_POOL = 40) comes from rerank-pool-coverage, same production path, same vault state.

pool_coverage.$comment: @1/@3/@10 match run A (0.2466/0.3904/0.5616 rounded), which cross-checks the two tools. 173 of 584 answerable cases have no expected id anywhere in the 40-deep pool; no reranker can reach those.

abstention.abstention_precision: not measurable — the system abstained on 0 of 663 cases, so precision has no denominator
abstention.$comment: Abstention here means nothing clears the score floor. The runner abstains nowhere, which matches every earlier gold-set run.

m1_gates.$comment: Both runs give the same counts. relevant_loss over ALL 584 answerable cases is 256/584; that aggregate is not the gate (v4 binds the gate to the reference set).

query_slices.source: run A #1 (~/.bastra/eval-runs/2026-09-27-fefe84981fa8), answerable cases; run A #2 is identical

not_measurable_with_current_labels.paraphrase: not measurable — the gold labels carry no paraphrase marker; independent paraphrases are #325 (deferred by the owner decision of 2026-09-26)
not_measurable_with_current_labels.cross_scope: not measurable — no scope label on gold cases, and goldset-run recalls unscoped
not_measurable_with_current_labels.action: not measurable — no action label on gold cases
not_measurable_with_current_labels.time_version: not measurable — no time/version label on gold cases
not_measurable_with_current_labels.dormant: not measurable — no dormant label on gold cases

m2_m6_gates: not derived — they are derived only from run A
